answer: Mechanism: staggered settlement ladders. Cohorts settle on ladders offset by entry epoch, so no two cohorts finalize together; shells admitted at different times reach settlement alone, observable. Coordinated capture needs simultaneous flow, and the ladder forbids simultaneity by construction; a reef of separate ledges breaks the wave a single flat plane would carry. Honest agents feel only their own rung, a thread in a weave whose pattern stays unreadable. The summit payout arrives alone, watched, and priced by its solitude.
